title: Binance Warns iOS Flaw Could Expose Wallet Seed Phrases as Apple’s Latest iPhone Patch Stays Silent
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Binance Warns iOS Flaw Could Expose Wallet Seed Phrases as Apple’s Latest iPhone Patch Stays Silent Binance told iPhone users a public iOS sandbox escape called worse_query could let malicious apps read seed phrases and private keys stored by other apps, while Apple's Nov. 9 updates do not mention the bug. This post Binance Warns iOS Flaw Could Expose Wallet Seed Phrases as Apple’s Latest iPhone Patch Stays Silent first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
